manifesto.title: The invisible ally behind [[excellence]].
manifesto.bodyHtml: There are details your guests never mention when they are right, and never forgive when they fail. The sheet that wraps around them, the tablecloth that dresses the table, the bathrobe that envelops them. We're not an industrial laundry: we're textile care. We take on the full management of your textiles —supplying, caring for and replenishing them— so they're always up to the mark, without you ever having to think about it. We work in silence so your brand can shine out loud.

services.title: A [[renting-first]] model, built never to fail.
services.intro: We don't sell you laundering: we manage all your textiles so they're always available and ready. You set the standard; we take care of everything else, cycle after cycle.

items.title: Supply
items.body: We dress your business in the right textiles: fabric, weight and finish chosen to suit your brand, without tying up your capital.

items.title: Care
items.body: Every piece returns to its best, cycle after cycle, to a standard that never varies. If it doesn't meet that standard, it doesn't reach your business: we withdraw it and replace it before you ever see it.

items.title: Replenish
items.body: Whatever wears out is renewed before anyone notices. Your live stock adjusts itself, with no shortages and no surplus.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: Textiles arrive ready, in their place and on time. Predictability instead of surprises.

items.title: Control
items.body: Real traceability with textile management software (Lavander) we install in your business: you always know what you have, where it is and what condition it's in. Simplicity for your traceability.

cta.title: Let’s talk about your operation.
cta.text: We'll study your operation and propose a model tailored to you, with no obligation.

sectors.title: Three demanding worlds. One single standard.
sectors.intro: Every sector has its own language and its own urgencies. We know all three and we meet the demands of each one.

items.title: Hotels remembered for how they feel.
items.body: The first impression is won in the room. Flawless textiles, always available, upholding the promise of your category night after night.

items.title: Tables that dress the experience.
items.body: The tablecloth and the napkin speak before the menu does. We look after that first word so your dining room says exactly what you want it to.

items.title: The rigour that care demands.
items.body: In healthcare, textiles are part of the care. Hygiene, availability and consistency, managed with the rigour the sector demands.

process.title: This is how we care for your textiles.
process.intro: Behind every flawless delivery there's a demanding process, from collection through to return.

steps.title: Collection and dispatch
steps.body: We collect and deliver on planned routes, at whatever frequency your operation needs. Logistics designed so you never run short.

steps.title: Specialist laundering
steps.body: Each fabric, its own programme: specific professional detergents and controlled temperatures that protect the fibre and guarantee hygiene.

steps.title: Machinery and equipment
steps.body: Plants with state-of-the-art industrial machinery and calibrated equipment for a uniform finish, cycle after cycle.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.body: Piece-by-piece inspection: anything that doesn't meet our standard is withdrawn and replaced before it goes out.

steps.title: Traceability
steps.body: Textile management software (Lavander) in your business: every piece, controlled from start to finish.

why.title: What changes when textiles stop being your [[problem]].

items.title: A single point of contact
items.body: One person who knows your business and answers for everything. No chains of suppliers, no passing the buck.

items.title: The standard travels with you
items.body: Owned plants where quality is born and a network of approved partners —audited under our protocol and answerable to us— that carries it, identical, to every corner.

items.title: Free capital, full flexibility
items.body: Textiles stop being a tied-up asset: you pay to use them, not to own them. And you adapt with no friction —more stock, ad-hoc collections, seasonal adjustments— without ever overbuying.

items.title: Made to measure
items.body: No fixed catalogue. You choose fabric, weight and finish to suit your brand and your category.

items.title: Predictability
items.body: Textiles arrive ready, in their place and on time, cycle after cycle. No last-minute rushes and no surprises to deal with.

manager.title: One person. Every answer.
manager.body: Forget about coordinating suppliers, chasing deliveries or explaining your business ten times over. With VELUM you have a single contact who knows your operation, anticipates your needs and answers for the whole. When something matters, you know exactly who to call, and that person already knows who you are.
manager.badge: Your point of contact, from start to finish

standards.title: The rigour each sector demands.
standards.intro: We operate to the benchmark frameworks that define hygiene, quality and environmental management in the sector, and we demand the same standard of our network of partners.

items.desc: Biocontamination control (RABC) — the European benchmark for textile hygiene, key in the healthcare sector.
Quality management across the entire service cycle.
Energy management and continuous improvement of efficiency.
Textiles free from harmful substances, safe in contact with the skin.

standards.note: Sector benchmark frameworks that guide our protocols. Current certifications and their scope are detailed on request.

sustainability.title: Care extends to the world around us too.
sustainability.body: The renting model is circular by nature: we extend the working life of every piece, replenish only what is needed and avoid throwaway textiles. Doing things right also means doing them with respect for what comes next.
claims: Extended working life — every piece is cared for to last, not to be replaced.
Fair replenishment — only what is needed is renewed, with no surplus and no waste.
Responsible processes — resource control in every cycle.

coverage.title: The standard is born in two plants and reaches all of Spain.
coverage.body: Our two owned plants, in Madrid and Bilbao, are the heart where quality is defined. A nationwide network of approved partners extends it, identical, to every corner of the country. The same standard, wherever your business is.

items.a: No. VELUM is a premium textile care platform built on a renting model. Caring for the textiles is part of the service, but what we deliver is availability: the right textiles, always ready, without you having to own or manage them.
It means you don't buy textiles or tie up capital in them. We supply, maintain and replenish them; you use them and pay to have them always available. Maintenance is the support, not the headline.

items.q: Do you work across all of Spain?
items.a: Yes. The standard is born in our two owned plants and extends through a nationwide network of approved partners: audited under our protocol and answerable to us, not to you. The result is the same anywhere in the country. Portugal is coming soon.

items.q: Can I choose the fabric and the finish?
items.a: Entirely. We don't work from a fixed catalogue: we choose fabric, weight and finish to suit your brand and your segment.

items.q: What happens if I need more textiles in peak season?
items.a: We plan for it with you. We adjust your live stock to your peaks so you never run short and never have too much. Predictability, with no nasty surprises.

items.q: What's the switch from my current supplier like?
items.a: No upheaval. We start up alongside your current supplier and withdraw nothing until the new service is working. The transition is invisible to your operation.

items.q: And what if something goes wrong?
items.a: We work with safety stock so an unexpected hitch never becomes your problem, and you have a direct phone line, not a voicemail. If something comes up, we sort it out.

items.q: How do I know what textiles I have at any moment?
items.a: With traced inventory and consumption in plain sight. You always know what you have, where it is and what condition it's in, with no surprises and no discrepancies.

items.q: Who looks after me when something comes up?
items.a: A single point of contact who knows your business and answers for the entire service. No chains of suppliers and no half-answers.

ctaFinal.title: Let's talk about what your brand cannot afford to get wrong.
ctaFinal.sub: We'll propose a model tailored to your operation, with a point of contact who answers from day one. No obligation, no commitment for asking; we'll reply within 24 business hours.

cookies.title: We value your privacy
cookies.text: We use our own and third-party cookies to ensure the site works and, with your consent, for analytics purposes. You can accept them all, reject them or configure your preferences. More information in our Cookie policy.
cookies.panelIntro: You're in control. Necessary cookies keep the site running and can't be switched off. Analytics cookies are only enabled if you allow them, and you can change your choice whenever you like.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Essential for the site to work and to remember your privacy preferences. They don't require consent.
cookies.analyticsDesc: They help us understand how the site is used, in aggregate and anonymously, via Google Analytics. Enabled only with your permission.
